items.briefing:
Australia is being urged to strengthen its defences against digital finance fraud, with experts calling for improved protections across financial services. Separately, the accounting sector is being encouraged to adopt phishing-resistant authentication methods to better comply with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and reduce the risk of credential-based attacks — a growing concern for firms handling sensitive financial data.

For everyday staff, the key takeaway is simple: be cautious of unexpected emails asking you to log in or verify your details. **Always access systems by typing the address directly into your browser rather than clicking links in emails.**

featured.title: Australia urged to bolster digital finance & fraud defences
featured.quote: Rising fraud and 2027 digital assets regime require Australian banks to urgently upgrade security infrastructure.
